fusions.name: Dropped Portcullis
fusions.desc: Edged bars fall around you, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, stunning them for 1 second and leaving them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Headsman's Appointment
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health: a falling chop deals 30 damage and leaves it 15% easier to wound and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hedge of Blades
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and it leaves them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Next to the Block
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
